Exercise: Suspended Fallout

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_extension
- external_rotation
- spinal_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- lower back
- shoulders

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- improving_shoulder_mobility_and_stability
- strengthening_the_upper_body,_particularly_the_shoulders_and_core

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Suspended Fallout with Bands, equipment: resistance bands
- name: Suspended Fallout with Weighted Vest, equipment: weighted vest

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Kettlebell Overhead Press, equipment: kettlebells
- exercise_name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Adjust the straps so the handles are at an appropriate height, below waist level.
- Begin standing and grasping the handles. Lean into the straps, moving to an incline push-up position. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your arms straight, lean further into the suspension straps, bringing your body closer to the ground, allowing your shoulders to extend, raising your arms up and over your head.
- Maintain a neutral spine and keep the rest of your body straight, your shoulders being the only joints allowed to move.
- Pause during the peak contraction, and then return to the starting position.
